dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCP (Message Control Program) framework typical of JMA ORCA
evidence: EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent
fixed format, LINKAGE SECTION with USING MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – disease name (病名) registration/search component C04
purpose.summary: This program implements the disease-name (byomei) registration and search screen (component C04) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles initialisation, screen transitions, entry processing, and DB lookups for patient disease names including user-defined disease names and standard disease master records. It is a subprogram called via the MCP framework with screen area linkage.

notable_features: MCP framework (MCPAREA, MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-PUTTYPE, MCP-WINDOW)
29 COPY statements including screen layouts (C02-C11, CERR, CID1-CID4) and data structures
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP DB access (900-USBYO-INV-SEC, 900-BYOMEI-READ-SEC)
User-defined disease name (自院病名) and standard disease master lookup
Screen SPA (scratchpad area) management across multiple screen components
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are Japanese EUC-JP encoded, appearing garbled. Content is clearly the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a well-known production system used by Japanese medical clinics. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of ~90860 bytes (2122 lines total); analysis based on first ~400 lines plus mechanical indicators.
